died.name: Frederick V of Denmark
died.last_words: It is a great consolation to me, in my last hour, that I have never wilfully offended anyone, and that there is not a drop of blood on my hands.

died.name: John Wolcot
died.cause: when asked, "Is there anything I can do for you?"

died.name: Prince Albert Victor, Duke of Clarence and Avondale
died.desc: second in line to the British throne
died.cause: he repeated these words over and over again while dying

died.name: Lewis Carroll
died.last_words: Take away these pillows, I won't need them any longer.

died.name: Humphrey Bogart
died.cause: to his wife Lauren as she left to collect their children, after which he entered a fatal coma

died.name: Kurt Gödel
died.cause: The 71-year-old logician and mathematician developed an obsessive fear of being poisoned and refused to eat food prepared by anyone but his wife. When she became ill and was hospitalized, he starved to death. At the time of his death, he only weighed around 65 lb.

died.name: Park Jong-chul
died.cause: to the police of the Anti-communist Detached Office, who tortured him by water cure, to force him to confess the whereabouts of one of his fellow activists

died.name: Daniel John O'Brien
died.cause: The 31-year-old American tourist took his own life by jumping into one of the engines of a British Airways Boeing 747 at Piarco International Airport, Trinidad. He is said to have scaled an airport wall in the nude, stolen a vehicle from four security guards, and smeared himself with grease before hurling himself into one of the plane's engines.

born.name: Benedict Arnold
born.cause: referring to his Continental Army uniform
born.last_words: Let me die in the old uniform in which I fought my battles for freedom. May God forgive me for putting on any other.

born.name: Yukio Mishima
born.last_words: Human life is limited; but I would like to live forever.

born.name: Rob Hall
born.cause: speaking to his wife by satellite phone before dying on Mount Everest
born.last_words: I love you. Sleep well, my sweetheart. Please don't worry too much.

born.name: Ricardo López
born.cause: before committing suicide with a gun after he mailed a bomb to Icelandic musician Björk, attempting to kill her
